missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Звезда' stays in the nominative case as the subject of 'светит'. 'Яркая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'на небе' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Звезду' is the accusative direct object of 'вижу'. 'Первую' agrees in the feminine accusative, marking the first star to appear.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Звезды' is in the genitive case after 'свет', expressing whose light it is. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К звезде' uses the dative form 'звезде' after 'к' to express direction. 'Далёкой' agrees in the feminine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental object. 'Звездой' is in the instrumental case required by 'любовался'. 'Яркой' agrees in the feminine instrumental, describing the bright star.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О звезде' uses the prepositional form 'звезде' after 'о' to mark the topic. 'Новой' agrees in the feminine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Звезда' is nominative as the subject of 'стала', here in the sense of a celebrity. 'Эта' points at a specific one.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Звёзды' is the nominative plural of 'звезда', acting as the subject of 'горят'. 'Ночью' adds the instrumental time, and 'на небе' the place.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Звёзд' is the genitive plural after 'много', expressing quantity. 'Ярких' agrees in the genitive plural, the object of 'рисуют'.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after preposition. 'Звёзд' uses the genitive plural after 'без' to express absence. 'Небо' is the nominative subject with the predicate 'пустое'.
